rules.general: General standard: at least 60 points per event (ATP 7-22.01, 12 Mar 2026, para. 2-30, p. 23). The app also applies a 300 total from army.mil (21 Apr 2025); with every event at 60 or more the total is always at least 300.
rules.combat: Combat standard: sex-neutral (Male | Combat column), at least 60 points per event and 350 total (ATP 7-22.01, 12 Mar 2026, para. 2-30, p. 23).
